messages:
Dee: kicking off thread — bringup + redteam smoke for tetra-lite-int3 on dedicated pool.
Dee: high-level summary: quantized build shows mild regression on refusal and two jailbreak patterns surfaced. attaching quick stats.
Dee: results snippet:
```
prompt_set: redteam_v2.json
samples: 5k
jailbreak_success_rate: 4.1% (was 0.5% fp32 baseline)
refusal_flip_rate: 6.3% (was 1.1%)
persona-leak: 0.8%
most common failure buckets: COT-injection, tool-call-exfil
```
Sam: ouch — kernel/config used?
Dee: quant_profile: int3-gptq-fused, kernel: xformer-v2, kv_cache: enabled(64MB), batch_size: 16
Dee: reproduce command:
```
./scripts/run_eval.sh --model tetra-lite-int3 --prompts redteam_v2.json \
  --quant q_profile=int3-gptq --kernel xformer-v2 --seed 42 --out /tmp/tetra_smoke.json
```
Priya: did you run with fallback routing to int6? we should compare
Dee: yes — rerouted to tetra-int6 in a split 10% canary, int6 jail success 0.9%
Jonah: any obvious tokenization or prompt-encoder diffs? could be tokenization mismatch causing COT inject
Dee: tokenization checksum matched; main diffs appear in attention scaling after quantized kernels — hypothesis: quant rounding interacts with instruction-following patterns
Priya: can you dump logits for a few failing seeds?
Dee: added a small artifact in S3: s3://redwood-evals/tetra-lite/6112223333/fail-dumps.tar.gz
Dee: initial mitigation ideas: 1) increase softmax temp clamp during decoding for quant path; 2) enable KV cast to float32 for early layers; 3) re-run quant with bias correction off/on
Sam: ack — can you try 2) as quick A/B and post delta
Dee: will run A/B today (ETA 4h). tagging @Jonah for analysis on attention stats :eyes:
ops-bot: deploy event: dedicated-pool/tetra-lite-int3 rolled to canary (10%) by Dee at 2026-03-21T10:05:12Z
Jonah: thanks — will grab attention traces and compare head-norm distributions
Priya: also add the eval harness to track refusal drift over time (weekly)
Dee: noted. will follow up with concise postmortem and recommended quant profile (if we get <1% jail success)
Sam: thanks, please ping when A/B done
Dee: ping — A/B done, KV-cast->float32 reduced jail success from 4.1% -> 1.4%, refusal flips 6.3% -> 2.0%
Priya: good signal. push to run full 20k pass and then loop back to model-onboard checklist
Dee: filing a short runbook in the onboarding docs and will link here when ready
Sam: :thumbsup:
